Welcome to the Canine Rehabilitation and Integrated Veterinary Center, your go-to destination for holistic dog care in Kingston, Washington! Led by Dr. Christine Finn, our center specializes in combining Eastern and Western veterinary medicine to address your dog's mobility issues and pain. With 13 years of expertise, we provide treatments that effectively alleviate discomfort without side effects, ensuring your dog can live their best, pain-free life.
Whether your dog is struggling with arthritis, recovering from surgery, or experiencing general mobility issues, we are here to help. Our comprehensive treatment plans are tailored to meet unique needs of each dog, ensuring optimal results.
Join our community of satisfied pet owners who have seen remarkable improvements in their dogs' quality of life. Contact us today to learn more about our services and to schedule a consultation with Dr. Christine Finn. Give your dog the gift of a pain-free, active life with the Canine Rehabilitation.
